profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Specialties: C/C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Objective-C, CSS, HTML/HTML5, XML, WPF, ActionScript, Silverlight, Graphics, OpenGL, Cairo, Skia, DirectX, SQL, JavaScriptCore (WebKit)

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Lead the Windows development for the Seagate Duet product, software which backs up and syncs a physical (1TB) hard drive to Amazon's Cloud Drive.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on the commerce team developing and improving upon features for the PlayStation store (PS4 and PS3)

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed many projects for clients like Alaska Airlines, AT&T, Cannes, Digby, Decide (eBay), Cannon, HBO, Sony, Epix, Lion Capital, Microsoft, Madison Square Garden, Wunderman, Starbucks, Seattle Sonics, Nike, Converse, BECU, Faconnable, Noble House Hotels, Aptimus, Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation, Godiva, Pella and many more…

Example Projects:

EPIX
Developed the Epix application for the Sony PlayStation, the PS3, PS4 and PSVita.
Used native C++, Sony's Trilithium JavaScript library as well as my own JavaScript based application and rendering framework.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=y83gxKzouJQ

Decide.com
Lead the iOS (iPhone and iPad) team and helped with the development of the Decide.com (acquired by eBay) application.
The application provided price prediction, comparison and recommendations for everyday projects.

Microsoft Hardware – Art of Touch Campaign
Developed a "digital" canvas that users can paint on using various brushes that produced fairly complex shapes, some of the brush designs came from in-house as well as inspiration from well-known artists.

The tech was pushing the limits back then using JavaScript, lots of math and rendering to an HTML5 2D canvas.

The artwork data which was a custom binary form of SVG/WPF path like data, was streamed in real-time to the backend.

With this data, we used it to composite it together with other artwork designs to create this large spatial environment that a user can navigate through. As well, the data could be scaled to any size and then printed on a large canvas, a mug, mouse pad, laptop case or anything else you wanted it to be physically printed on.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FE-QAOcWZBc

positions.title: Consultant - iOS / Android
positions.description:
Added a 2D Parallax view to a comic book reader in their existing Burn Notice app, for both Android and iOS.

Multiple layers, video, images, also added audio playback. Accelerometer support, OpenGL rendering, iOS CoreVideo. Supports iPhone/iPad and Android phone/tablet.

And helped fix a few existing issues that were causing some crashes.

positions.title: Senior ActionScript Engineer
positions.description: Helped work on initial port and rewrite of legacy AS code to AS3 for Club Penguins until the development direction suddenly changed.

positions.title: Senior iOS Software Engineer
positions.description:
Helped with the development of various MSNBC branded projects for iOS (iPhone and iPad).

The apps included brands like Nightly News, TODAY show, Rachel Maddow and others.

Because many of the apps where much alike, built a templated system from the TODAY show application that we can use a starting to point for other brands.

Included various tech like integrating Twitter and Facebook API's, Urban Airship for Push Notifications and TouchXML for XPath support.

positions.title: Software Development Consultant
positions.description: Rebuilt their backend (CMS) based system to their Insyte Viewer tool that managed reports and various chart configurations as well as channel management for users and servers.

positions.title: Software Engineering Consultant
positions.description:
Helped porting their existing Windows based (WPF) application over to the Mac.

Helped with the development of the UI, which included quite complex transitions and rendering of fairly large datasets.

positions.title: Consultant - Flex/ActionScript Developer
positions.description:
Developed a quilt customizer for Nostalgia Home Fashions using Flex/Flash. The web-based application allowed users to create their own styles of quilts, it supported loading dynamic template rendering, capturing screen data to PNG, rendering of final designs.

Helped the development of the backend XML/JSON services for the quilt customizer.

Developed various Flash based modules to run on kiosks inside T-Mobile stores for their HTC HD2, Garminfone and myTouch. These modules supported various transitions and 360 degree viewer of the products and an FLV based video player.

positions.title: Senior UI and Video Engineer
positions.description:
Built internal installers for numerous services.

Developed the Windows UI for the media library and playback from the MOD Systems (GreenDot) SD cards, similar to iTunes today.

Implemented the DirectShow based codec (filters) along with a PMP based solution for secure video playback.

Helped with the development of the embedded GreenDot media player (set-top-box) running on a custom Linux distro for a MIPS chipset.

positions.title: CTO and Co-Founder
positions.description: C#, ASP.NET, Win32, C++, DirectX, Audio Recording, Screen Recording, LAME, Flex/AIR/ActionScript, Web Services.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer and International Development Lead
positions.description:
Designed and developed the web services API used by large law firms for batch processing of a large number of case filings. 

Lead the team both locally and off-shore (InfoSys) to update the entire File and Serve system to support multiple languages and cultures (i.e. localization, globalization, internalization)
Helped define and implement new processes to handle larger load and the ability to scale out the backend windows services that handled OCR and categorization of various metadata from legacy court systems mainframes into centralized MS SQL databases in the LexisNexis data centers.

positions.title: Senior Engineer / Architect
positions.description: C#, ASP.NET, XML, XSL, SQL, JavaScript/Ajax, CyberSource Payment API, SSL.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Being an agency, I was involved with the development of a variety of websites and applications across all tech stacks.

See Possible Worldwide above for some project examples.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Created the original backend content management systems and tools to allow internal and external editing of car dealer inventory.

Designed and developed 30-40 websites for a variety of car dealerships within the Pacific Northwest region.

Helped design inventory management tools and the processes used for field technicians for generating the vehicle inventory database and dealer labels on embedded hardware devices (e.g. label printers, barcode scanners)

positions.title: Content and Tools Developer
positions.description:
Developed transformation tools to manage various forms of media.

Implemented processes for streamlining content ingestion.

Developed automation scripts for testing the validity of the content, for example, usage of proper grammar and spelling.
